title: A lesson step
text: A down is one play. The offense gets 4 downs, four tries, to move the ball 10 yards. When you hear 1st and 10, that means first down with 10 yards to go.

title: A situation with choices
text: 1st and 10. Ball on the other team's 35. You have run the ball 4 times in a row. What is your call? Your choices are: Play Action Post, or Inside Zone Right, or Running Back Screen.

title: Feedback after an answer
text: Great call! The safeties are cheating up to stop the run. Fake the run, and the deep middle is wide open for the post.
